So leave social media alone. It was created to monitor you, brainwash you and control you. God is going to save the poor from their mouth, and their own tongue will bring them down.

precepts.why:
“Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world.” To spoil is to despoil and corrupt. It is a vain deceit because there is covetousness behind it, reward behind it, gifts. The rudiments are the elements of the world, of man. David shows who is behind those traditions: “They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?”

Who are they? Go up to verse 2: “Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity.” The secret counsel of the wicked are the elite that sit back and research and study ancient pagan cultures and ancient Eastern cultures and incorporate them into our society today. Some call them Illuminati, some call them the Luciferians. It is all of them: Bilderbergs, Duponts, Rothschilds, whatever. An elite group that runs this world behind the scenes and builds the customs and societal norms we grew up in, that we believed were righteous and are not. And we reference the customs of these elite demons as if they were God himself.

They “commune of laying snares”: they communicate, have conversations, think tanks. The snares are doctrines, religions, philosophies, politics, laid privily for our people, who they know are the real people of God. “Who shall see them?” You do not know a Luciferian if you meet one; he has to tell you he is part of a secret society. They are known, but they are not known.

“They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search.” They search out iniquities from the ancient mystic civilisations: Babylon, Assyria, Rome, Greece, Canaan, the Sidonians, the Germanic cultures, Norse folklore. Their archaeologists do diligent searches and excavations, dig these things up, revamp them, commercialise them and make them appealing and alluring to the foolish and ignorant. And “both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.”

They have all kinds of slick ways: television, radio, propaganda, advertisement. That is their signs and wonders, and it is all witchcraft. They will get you one way or the other, through influence, music and fashion. Rudolph the red-nosed reindeer, Jingle Bells: you have to check yourself because it is catchy. That is the tradition of men Paul warned about, spoiling our people through the holidays.
